intent: The ground loop's device page displays its state from the liveness record — last run, state, and pid — as a declared pane.
why: A read-projection of the record, not a second source. The pane computes nothing about liveness; it renders what the loop wrote. Every surface is a view (the bus/one-web-server rule).
falsifier: The pane displays a liveness the record does not say — i.e. it derives or caches rather than renders. And: the pane must be honest when the record is STALE or ABSENT, showing 'not running' or 'unknown' rather than blank or a last-known-good.

BUILDME.need: ground-loop-writes-its-own-liveness — the pane renders that record
the ground loop gets a device PAGE the way every device does — a declared pane via BaseShim, never its own route or port (memory: one-web-server-surfaces-in-the-shim)

watchme: none, because a pure read-projection's falsifier is settled by a proof, not by time.
cursor_correction_2026-07-30: Cast with the cursor at [BUILDME], corrected to [THINKME] within the hour. A cursor AT a stage means that stage was ENTERED — superclaude-starts-itself rests at [PROVEME] with its BUILDME gate already satisfied — so [BUILDME] on a freshly cast leaf claims a crossing that never rode the chokepoint. It cannot have: since ticket buildme-rides-the-chart (2026-07-29) the entry gate refuses a BUILDME crossing unless a berthed validate packet claims the ticket, and a census of all 89 berths finds ZERO claiming any ticket in this family. Hand-writing the cursor forward is precisely the hand-edit of a record of truth that transitions.emit exists to prevent (Law 4). The stage is reachable only by /chart, then the door.
the_threshold_this_renders: THE STALENESS THRESHOLD IS 5 SECONDS — five missed ticks at the ruled once-per-second cadence. Ruled by Akien 2026-07-31. Three times the interval is the standard liveness heuristic; five gives slack for a loaded box without anyone noticing the lag. LIVE = last-run within 5s. DEAD = last-run older than 5s, whatever the file says about state, whatever pid it names. A crashed loop leaves the file behind but STOPS ADVANCING THE TIMESTAMP — that is the whole detector, and it is Akien's, present in the design from the first telling.
honesty_requirement: The pane applies the same 5s rule as the start-guard and gets it from the same place — one implementation of a settled question (Law 1). A pane with its own opinion about how stale is dead is a second answer that will drift from the first.
